Dream 2026-11-22 linked 5 vignettes from 4 days to this record as evidence. Agree if they belong here; disagree to have a later dream drop them.

- 2026-10-22 · touches · "assigning a decision to a pole, and then cross checking with other decisions" (Cluster on the T3 axes, and keep a document of discoveries (2026-10-22))
- 2026-10-28 · touches · "base trigram axes and poles affirmed? These should apply by default" (Base trigram axes and poles apply by default; every decision gets a trigram, and consistency builds the system (2026-10-28))
- 2026-10-28 · touches · "We should b careful of mixing synthetic logic lenses." (Do not mix synthetic logic lenses: the compass rows are individual/relational/systemic; the three axes are its diagonals (2026-10-28))
- 2026-11-06 · touches · "I could only assign a category when I could see how it related to what was around it." (A domain is a boundary: every statement and affirmation exists only relative to it, and zooming into fire finds all the elements again (2026-11-06))
- 2026-11-10 · retells · "They are often the most difficult layer of a domain to affirm. this is why we have been looking into working with default axes." (Poles are often the most difficult layer of a domain to affirm; this is why we work with default axes (2026-11-10))
